name: character-creation
title_zh: 静态立绘到分层动作一步到位，角色素材不返工
tagline_zh: 做卡牌角色最怕画完动不了、动完对不上。它按烬域规范拆好分层、绑好实例，批量角色也一次过验收，省下反复改文件的夜。
tagline_en: Tired of art that can't animate or rigs that don't match? It splits layers and binds instances to Emberfall spec.
desc_en: 为烬域 Emberfall / card-game 项目制作或修复角色静态与动态素材，维护完整角色清单、分层动作与实例绑定，并接入现有游戏完成验收。适用于单卡、批量角色和角色制作规范任务。
why_zh: 把角色清单当唯一事实源，从静态到动态的每一步都校验命名与结构，错一步当场拦下。
why_en: Treats the character list as single source of truth, validating naming and structure at every step—catches errors before they.
limit_zh: 只认烬域 Emberfall 的目录与命名规范，素材需已按该规范分层导出 PSD/PNG。
limit_en: Only works with Emberfall's folder & naming spec; assets must be pre-layered PSD/PNG. No gameplay stats or art style—just structure, rigging, and.
title_en: Static art to layered animation, character assets without.
